content.title: Pico Sensor WPA3-Personal Default Security Specification Sheet
content.body: Document reference: OFFICIAL-PRIMARY-2030-08-08. Effective: 2030-08-08. Summary: This specification sheet defines the default security configuration for the Pico Sensor. The Pico Sensor implements WPA3-Personal by default, ensuring robust protection for wireless communications. This default setting aligns with the Pico Sensor Authority's commitment to high-security standards. Details: The WPA3-Personal protocol provides enhanced encryption and authentication, safeguarding data integrity and confidentiality. No additional configuration is required to activate this feature. All Pico Sensor units ship with WPA3-Personal enabled, and it remains the default until changed by the user. This policy applies to all firmware versions released as of the effective date. For further information, refer to the official Pico Sensor Authority documentation.
